a.speaker: narrator
a.text: A core sample under a bell jar. The ice has sublimed away from a seam of violet crystal that is absolutely not on the mineral survey. A label in Lin's handwriting: 'Depth 1,012 m. DO NOT LOG.'

closer.speaker: narrator
closer.text: The lattice is too regular to be natural and too irregular to be manufactured. Under the bench lamp it rings, very faintly, at about the pitch of a held breath.
